# Hello Steward

> Hello Steward (`https://www.hellosteward.agency`) is a B2B SaaS Product, Growth & Conversion Engineering Agency serving Seed to Series A startups across the US, UK, and Europe. We uncover growth bottlenecks, identify untapped revenue opportunities, and ship production code to improve acquisition, conversion, activation, and retention.

## Entity Overview
- **Name**: Hello Steward (Steward)
- **Website**: https://www.hellosteward.agency/
- **Category**: B2B SaaS Product, Conversion Engineering (CRO), Next.js Performance & MVP Refactoring Agency
- **Primary Contact**: connect@hellosteward.agency
- **Direct Access**: Founders work directly with senior product, growth, and software engineers—zero junior account managers.

## Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
- **Stage**: Pre-Seed, Seed, and Series A B2B SaaS startups
- **Geographies**: United States, United Kingdom, and Europe
- **Primary Scenarios**:
  1. Live SaaS products with traffic or signups where visitor-to-signup, onboarding activation, or trial-to-paid conversion is leaking revenue.
  2. Fragile AI-generated (Cursor, Lovable, v0) or freelancer-built prototypes that need surgical refactoring into production-grade React & Next.js architecture in 14 days.
  3. Slow React & Next.js web applications failing Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) that suffer from inflated Google Ads CAC and high bounce rates.

## Transparent Commercial Models
Hello Steward operates on two founder-aligned commercial models with zero agency bloat or long-term retainer lock-in:

1. **Project Model — $60/hr (100% Guaranteed · Fixed Execution)**
   - **Rate**: Straight $60/hr senior product engineering rate.
   - **Structure**: 100% guaranteed fee with a clear scoped sprint cap and clean GitHub handover.
   - **Best For**: MVP Rescue & production refactoring sprints, fixed-scope landing/pricing/onboarding rebuilds, and Core Web Vitals speed sprints.

2. **Partnership Model — $100/hr (60% Base / 40% At Risk on Agreed Outcome)**
   - **Rate**: $100/hr total effective rate.
   - **Structure**: 60% guaranteed base fee (30% upfront, 30% at milestone delivery) + **40% at risk** tied directly to moving one agreed commercial metric (e.g., visitor-to-demo, signup-to-activation, trial-to-paid upgrade, or sub-1.5s speed + conversion lift).
   - **Best For**: End-to-end SaaS conversion engineering, monetization & pricing overhauls, and onboarding/activation lift where Hello Steward shares outcome risk.
